title: Knight Summoning Magic
description: A knight in full armor with a red plume kneels in an enchanted forest, reaching toward an open glowing spellbook resting on a stone pedestal. Magical purple energy, floating runes, and a broken sword emitting blue light surround the scene as beams of light pierce through the misty trees.
prompt: A knight in detailed plate armor with a long red plume kneels in a misty enchanted forest, one hand reaching toward an ancient glowing spellbook open on a stone pedestal inscribed with text. Purple magical energy and floating runes swirl around the book while a broken sword lies on the ground emitting blue light. Dramatic god rays shine through the dense canopy of twisted trees at dusk, with purple flowers and mist throughout the scene.
